اقتطفتن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَفْتُنَّ (iqtaṭaftunna) /iq.ta.tˤaf.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# اُقْتُطِفْتُنَّ (uqtuṭiftunna) /uq.tu.tˤif.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
